title.narrative: Harnessing Property Rights in Greater Busia Metro, 2025-2028

description.narrative: The development objective is: “to improve local economic development in the Greater Busia Metro (GBM) by improving the governance of land and property rights, especially for informal women and youth traders”.

The project aims to assess the complex interplay of housing, land, and property rights in East African border towns of Busia, exploring the challenges faced by residents, especially the informal women and youth traders, and identifying opportunities for improving livelihoods, local economic development, and strengthening local governance. The intervention will examine the critical role of secure tenure in promoting economic development and social well-being and seek to highlight innovative approaches and collaborative efforts that can empower communities and foster sustainable growth in the Busia towns in Uganda and Kenya.
